name: Goethe
q: The master reveals himself in limits
Gray is theory, green is life
Two souls dwell in my breast
Happy days in a row are hardest to bear
I hear the message, but I lack faith
Man errs as long as he strives
My earthly trace outlasts the eons
All that is transient is but a semblance
One learns only from what one loves
The eternal feminine draws us upward
All theory is gray, and green the golden tree of life
Everyone hears only what he understands
Talent is formed in stillness, character in the stream of the world
Stay a while, moment — you are so beautiful
